description: This file defines an AgentTaskRunner class for executing agent-driven tasks such as generating commit messages and creating pull requests, with support for fallback mechanisms and polling for task completion. It also includes pre-defined task creation functions for commit and pull request operations.

classes.name: AgentTaskRunner
classes.description: Handles executing tasks by sending instructions to agents and polling for their completion, with logging and fallback support.

methods.name: executeTask
methods.description: Executes a given agent task by sending instructions and waiting for completion or fallback.

methods.name: pollForCompletion
methods.description: Polls periodically to check if a task has completed within a timeout.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the output channel.

methods.name: createCommitTask
methods.description: Creates a task instructing the agent to generate a commit message and commit staged changes.

methods.name: createPullRequestTask
methods.description: Creates a task instructing the agent to create a pull request from the current branch.
